condition: JY DeltaBC, W6/32, retained classical HLA-A*02:01
index_rule: First numbered edited clone (DeltaBC1), union of both its nested technical measurements, selected from experimental metadata, never detection richness or Teacher scores
followup_outcome: Binary direct detection in DeltaBC2 in either of its two technical measurements; retain both nested technical indicators separately
eligible_peptides: Source-accepted, unmodified canonical uppercase 9mers with original run-specific MS/MS evidence; no predicted HLA-affinity filter
confidence_policy: Preserve original source PSM acceptance and confidence; exclude reverse/contaminant flags; require published run membership and original MS/MS count and IDs. No new PEP cutoff or recalibration
duplicate_policy: Keep every original evidence row and ID; one presence per peptide per original run; sum intensity once per unique unmodified direct evidence-feature ID
index_intensity: Arithmetic mean of positive available per-run summed unmodified direct evidence-feature intensities across the two index-clone runs; zero/nonfinite/missing treated as unavailable, never as peptide absence
future_intensity_adjustment: Secondary linear regression of binary biological followup detection on within-HLA Teacher rank and centered log2 index intensity, with a missing-intensity indicator if needed; no new covariates selected from results
future_sensitivity: Exclude exact/one-substitution neighbors of any actual Teacher fitting peptide across HLA, minimum Hamming distance >=2; training and validation exposure reported separately
minimum_for_coefficient: At least 2 peptides and nonconstant predictor and outcome; N<30 or minority outcome count<10 flagged sparse; never change fixed cohort or index to meet counts
future_biological_CI: Undefined with one dependence component; no peptide-independent bootstrap substitute
